name: Period 8 Choice
definition: Choice between date and date-time for the specification of a period.

DateTime.name: Date Time
DateTime.definition: Date and time period is limited to a single date.

FromDateTime.name: From Date Time
FromDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the date period range starts.

ToDateTime.name: To Date Time
ToDateTime.definition: Date and time which the range date period ends.

FromDateToDate.name: From Date To Date
FromDateToDate.definition: Time span defined by a start date and time, and an end date and time.
